segments.text:
V. 45.
Who then is the faithful and wiſe ſervant—Which of you aſpires after this Character? Wiſe—Every Moment retaining the cleareſt Conviction, That all he now has is only intruſted to him as a Steward: Faithful—Thinking, ſpeaking, and acting continually, in a Manner ſuitable to that Conviction.
